BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

2. When learning Doors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Doors.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Doors.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Doors.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Doors.

3. When learning Windows, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Windows.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Windows.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Windows.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Windows.

4. When learning Construction Plant, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Plant.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Plant.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Plant.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Construction Plant.

5. When learning Construction Hand Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Hand Power Tools.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Construction Hand Power Tools.

6. When learning Sanitary Appliances, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Sanitary Appliances.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Sanitary Appliances.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Sanitary Appliances.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Sanitary Appliances.

7. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Information and Communication Technology

8. When learning Roof Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Roof Construction.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Roof Construction.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Roof Construction.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Roof Construction.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

10. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

12. When learning Appropriate Technology in Building, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Appropriate Technology in Building.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Appropriate Technology in Building.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Appropriate Technology in Building.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Appropriate Technology in Building.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Site Organisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Appropriate Technology in Building and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Orthographic Projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Computer Aided Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. A — CPU

2. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Doors.

3. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Windows.

4. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Plant.

5. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Hand Power Tools.

6. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Sanitary Appliances.

7. D — Information and Communication Technology

8. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Roof Construction.

9. D — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

10. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.

11. A — Never touch live wires with wet hands

12. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Appropriate Technology in Building.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Site Organisation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Appropriate Technology in Building; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Orthographic Projection; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Computer Aided Drawing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
